Quando este curso fala em IA, fala em mo: When this course talks about AI, it means language models, the LLMs. A model is a mechanism trained to produce text from what you give it. There are several, with different names, sizes and costs, and the first question is usually which one is best. That question has no useful answer: there is no best model, there is the model suited to the task, the deadline, the cost and the level of checking that work requires. That is why this module compares models against a real task rather than against opinions. A model produces answers; a system organises how those answers become work. OSWork combines model, interface, files, instructions, tools, memory and automations. Think of a small workshop: the professional's skill matters, but tools, materials and quality criteria also determine the result. We are not installing a new computer operating system: we use that expression as a metaphor for organisation.
Sem essa distinção, toda falha vira tent: Without this distinction, every failure turns into an attempt to write a larger prompt. Sometimes only the input file, a permission, or the way to verify the output is missing. Separating the pieces allows you to fix the right point.

Tipos de IA e para que servem: Kinds of AI and what they are for
Antes de comparar nomes, separe por funç: Before comparing names, sort by function. Language models, the LLMs, write, summarise, explain and program: that is where families like GPT sit, with Sol, Terra and Luna, GPT-6 Astra, and the Claude family, with Opus and Fable. Image and video models generate or edit visual material. And there are classification models, such as Jev, which do not converse: they take alternatives and return a choice, a yes or no, or a score. There are also hubs, which give access to several providers through a single point: OpenRouter for language models and Kie for image and video. Names, versions and availability change; this reading is from 20/09/2026.
Adotar um modelo como o melhor fecha a p: Adopting one model as the best closes the door on everything that model does not do. An excellent LLM will not generate a video, and a classifier will not write your report. Understanding what each kind is for comes before choosing, and the choice happens when the task appears, and may be different the following week. Availability also varies by account, client, authentication and rollout.
Texto; imagem; vídeo; classificação; cen: Text; image; video; classification; access hubs; availability.
O modelo é o mecanismo escolhido. O esfo: The model is the chosen mechanism. Reasoning effort is a setting of that mechanism. Higher levels may consume more time and tokens, units of text processing. The selector names change between Chat, Work, and Codex; there is no single list of Instant, Medium, High, and Pro that represents all products.
Pedir o máximo em toda tarefa pode aumen: Requesting the maximum on every task can increase consumption without improving the result. Increasing effort also does not provide a missing document. First complete the inputs, then assess whether the problem requires more analysis.
Modelo e esforço são eixos diferentes; c: Model and effort are different axes; start with the default; compare under equal conditions.
Uma régua transforma opinião em observaç: A rubric turns opinion into observation. Define before the request which facts must appear, which errors are unacceptable, and how the output will be used. Use three small criteria: fidelity to the data, combined format, and verifiability of the conclusions.
Sem critério, você escolhe a resposta ma: Without criteria, you choose the prettiest answer. A report can sound convincing and alter values. The test should reflect the work you need to deliver, not a demonstration made to impress.
Aceitação; evidência; amostra representa: Acceptance; evidence; representative sample; controlled comparison.
Login com ChatGPT usa os direitos e limi: Signing in with ChatGPT uses the rights and limits tied to the account and the workspace. An API key uses pay-per-use billing on the platform. Subscribing to ChatGPT does not mean receiving free balance for any program that calls the API. Hubs such as OpenRouter and Kie have their own credit, billed per use and separate from any subscription. Check the active method before a long run.
Esse cuidado evita descobrir depois que: This precaution avoids discovering later that an experiment is consuming a different account. Usage limits, model access, and data rules can change; the source of truth is the current configuration of your account.
Assinatura; autenticação; API; consumo;: Subscription; authentication; API; consumption; spending limit.
Autonomia é uma autorização com escopo,: Autonomy is an authorization with scope, not an invitation to do anything. Combine objective, permitted files, authorized actions, time limit, and stop condition. The output must include what was done and how it was verified.
Um agente pode executar mais etapas que: An agent can execute more steps than a chat, including making multiple mistakes. A simple limit protects time, budget, and files without preventing useful work. Technical permission and written instruction complement each other.
Escopo; aprovação de ações externas; tet: Scope; approval of external actions; execution ceiling; reviewable result.
Chat é uma interface de conversa. Você a: Chat is a conversational interface. You present a question, receive an answer, and can adjust the request. It works well for clarifying a concept or drafting a message. Additional features vary: a chat can also work with files and tools when available. The pedagogical distinction is the task’s intent, not a technical prohibition.
Reconhecer uma necessidade pequena evita: Recognizing a small need prevents building an automation for something that only requires an answer. The best environment is the one that lets you verify delivery with minimal friction.
Work permite delegar uma tarefa com resu: Work allows delegating a task with a reviewable result, such as an analysis or a document. It can use approved files and tools. Instead of monitoring every sentence, you define what must exist at the end and track the relevant steps. Availability depends on the account and environment.
Trabalhos com várias entradas precisam d: Jobs with multiple inputs need a definition of done. Without it, the agent may keep researching when you only needed a comparison of three options.
Objetivo; fontes; entrega; limites; cond: Goal; sources; delivery; limits; stop condition.
Desktop significa aplicativo instalado n: Desktop means an application installed on the computer. In compatible environments, it can access folders and applications with permission. The presence of the application does not grant universal access to your documents. If a tool is unavailable, provide the files via a supported path.
Muitas falhas de tarefa são falhas de ac: Many task failures are access failures: the learner assumes the agent sees a folder, but it wasn’t shared. Checking the context before execution prevents conclusions about documents the model never read.

Local é a execução na sua máquina. Nuvem: Local execution runs on your machine. Cloud execution runs on remote infrastructure. A local job depends on power, network, and computer permissions. Some environments offer cloud execution that continues without the machine being on; this depends on the functionality, not just the Work name.
Uma automação não fica permanente porque: An automation isn’t permanent because it was started in a modern interface. You need to know where the process lives, where the files are, and which connections it depends on.
Localização da execução; persistência; a: Execution location; persistence; file access; continuity.
Um bom pedido contém objetivo, contexto,: A good request contains objective, context, inputs, constraints, result, and verification. These are fields of an order, not magic words. The easier it is to inspect the output, the easier it will be to detect a deviation before it becomes rework.
O agente não precisa adivinhar se você q: The agent doesn’t need to guess whether you want an explanation, an editable file, or a publication. Naming the artifact and the ready condition shortens the distance between intention and execution.

Uma entrega só termina depois da conferê: A delivery only ends after the review. Open the file, compare numbers with the sources, and test the relevant links or formulas. Ask the agent for evidence of what it verified, distinguishing executed tests from suggested tests.
A frase “pronto” não demonstra que o arq: The word “ready” does not demonstrate that the file opens or that all data were preserved. A small independent verification often finds more problems than a new generic improvement request.

Terminal é a janela em que você escreve: The terminal is the window where you write commands for the computer. The shell is the program that interprets those commands. Here the terminal examples use Bash on Linux or macOS; on Windows, use a Bash environment via WSL or follow the official installer for Windows. Do not paste Linux commands directly into PowerShell without adaptation.
Saber em qual ambiente você está evita e: Knowing which environment you are in avoids errors that seem like AI failures. The cd command changes the current folder; pwd shows the location in Bash. You do not need to memorize dozens of commands to get started.

The installation command downloads and runs an official script; read the source, check the domain and use your own account. Do not run commands received from unknown pages.
Instalação, login e execução são etapas: Installation, login and execution are different steps. A program that is installed still needs authentication. A completed login does not mean you opened the correct folder.

If you choose the API, the key must be in the OPENAI_API_KEY variable; pipe it via standard input, without typing it in the command. A .env file alone does not authenticate Codex: some mechanism must load the variable.

O chat era o mesmo nas duas vezes; o mod: The chat was the same both times; the model didn’t change.
Trocar de tela não faz a IA inventar. O: Switching screens doesn’t make the AI invent. What changed was what it received.
Metade da pauta ficou de fora, e a IA co: Half of the agenda was left out, and the AI filled in the rest. The missing piece was the material that was sent.
Cada resposta vai para \"pede mudança\": Each answer goes to “request change” or “doesn’t request”; choosing between closed alternatives is the job of a classifier.
Um resumo junta as respostas num texto e: A summary puts the answers into one text and loses the count; it needs each answer in a category.
Ser o mais novo não diz nada sobre a fun: Being the newest doesn’t say anything about the function. Function first, then the name.
Pode ter sido a segunda planilha. Com do: It could have been the second spreadsheet. With two things changing at once, you can’t separate them.
Mudaram o esforço e o material ao mesmo: They changed the effort and the material at the same time. To know, repeat changing only one.
A primeira rodada nem teve o mesmo mater: The first round didn’t even have the same material; it proves nothing about the pattern.
Os dados da ata estão todos lá e nada fo: The minutes data is all there and nothing was changed.
A seção de pendências está lá; o formato: The pending items section is there; the format was followed.
A conclusão “saiu motivada” não tem de o: The conclusion “it came out motivated” doesn’t come from anywhere in the minutes. Ask to remove it or show the source.
O limite do chat e o crédito da central: The chat limit and the hub credit are different accounts; waiting for one doesn’t refill the other.
Um plano maior do chat não põe crédito n: A bigger plan for the chat doesn’t put credit in the central.
O crédito da central é próprio e cobrado: The central’s credit is separate and charged based on usage: you refill it in the central itself.
Sem ações listadas, “organizar” pode inc: With no listed actions, “organize” can include deleting. Write what can and can’t be done.
Mais tempo não teria impedido o agente d: More time wouldn’t have stopped the agent from deleting; the actions limit, yes.
O objetivo estava lá: organizar. O que f: The goal was there: organize. What was missing was explaining how.
Uma colega diz que vai trocar de IA porq: A colleague says they’re going to switch AI because the summary came out with the wrong name. What do you ask them before the switch?
Que material a IA recebeu. Se a lista de: What material the AI received. If the list of names wasn’t sent, any model will guess, and the switch won’t fix it.
Qual a diferença entre um modelo e um si: What’s the difference between a model and an AI work system?
O modelo produz respostas. O sistema jun: The model produces answers. The system combines model, interface, files, instructions, tools, memory, and automations so the answers become verified work.
A IA diz que gravou a planilha, mas o ar: The AI says it saved the spreadsheet, but the file doesn’t exist. Which part do you investigate?
The tool and the permission to save. The text of the request doesn’t create that capability.
Você quer transformar a foto da turma nu: You want to turn the class photo into an illustrated poster. What type of model does this task require?
Um modelo de imagem. Um modelo de texto: An image model. A text model can help describe the poster, but it doesn’t generate the image.
Por que anotar a data ao lado do nome de: Why write the date next to the name of a model?
Porque nomes, versões e disponibilidade: Because names, versions, and availability change. The date tells you when that choice was verified.
Um colega vê um modelo no seletor dele q: A colleague sees a model in their picker that doesn’t show up in yours. What could explain the difference?
A disponibilidade varia por conta, plano: Availability varies by account, plan, authentication, and release.
Em que situação um classificador pode se: In what situation could a classifier be better than an AI conversation?
Quando a tarefa é escolher entre poucas: When the task is choosing among a small set of closed options, across many items, and you need to review them in bulk.
Você subiu o esforço e a resposta ficou: You increased the effort and the answer got longer, but with no new facts. Does that count as improvement?
Não. Melhora é algo que você aponta: um: No. Improvement is something you point to: one more fact, one less error, a correct calculation. Length isn’t evidence.
Qual a diferença entre trocar o modelo e: What’s the difference between switching the model and switching the reasoning effort?
Trocar o modelo muda o mecanismo. Trocar: Switching the model changes the mechanism. Switching the effort changes how the same mechanism analyzes before answering.
A IA errou porque você não colou a segun: The AI made a mistake because you didn’t paste the second spreadsheet. What do you do before touching any controls?
Completa a entrada: cola a planilha que: Complete the input: paste the missing spreadsheet and run again using the standard pattern.
Por que escrever a régua antes de ler a: Why write the rubric before reading the response, and not after?
Escrita depois, a régua tende a aprovar: Writing after, the rubric tends to approve what came in. Writing before, it measures what you need, without getting swayed by tone.
Uma resposta perdeu um responsável, mas: A response lost its owner, but it’s written very well. What criterion does it fail?
Fidelidade aos dados. Elegância não comp: Fidelity to the data. Elegance doesn’t make up for a lost fact.
Para que serve guardar uma resposta ruim: What’s the point of saving a bad response along with the rubric?
Ela mostra o erro que você quer evitar e: It shows the error you want to avoid and helps you test the next model with the same case.
Um colega vai colar a chave de API num d: A colleague is going to paste the API key into a shared document so the team can use it. What do you recommend?
Não colar. A chave identifica quem paga;: Don’t paste it. The key identifies who pays; exposed, anyone can spend on the account. In the sheet, only include the method.
Qual a diferença entre entrar com a cont: What’s the difference between signing in with the chat account and using an API key?
A conta usa os direitos e limites do pla: The account uses the plan’s rights and limits. The key is billed for usage on the API platform, in a separate account.
O crédito de uma central acabou no meio: The credit for a central ran out in the middle of a batch of images, but the chat subscription is active. Why did the batch stop?
Porque o crédito da central é separado d: Because the central credit is separate from any subscription.
Um agente tem acesso à pasta inteira do: An agent has access to the entire project folder, but the task only needs one file. What should the authorization say?
Which files it can use: only that one. Broader technical access is not authorization.
Qual a diferença entre permissão técnica: What’s the difference between technical permission and written authorization?
A permissão técnica limita o que a ferra: Technical permission limits what the tool can do. Written authorization tells it what you want it to do and where to stop.
O agente entregou o relatório sem dizer: The agent delivered the report without saying how it checked the numbers. What do you ask for?
O fechamento em três partes: o que fez,: The three-part close: what you did, how you verified it, and what’s still pending.

name: relatorio-semanal
description: Generate a draft of a weekly report when the user provides a sales CSV. Don’t use it to send reports or handle credentials.

# Weekly report

## Input
CSV specified by the user, containing product and value. Use only sources explicitly authorized.

## Procedure
1. Read README.md and the project instructions.
2. Check the header, line count, and values; explain invalid fields.
3. Calculate totals with an available calculation tool, without inventing missing data.
4. Produce output/relatorio.md with sources, known total, valid records, and pending items.
5. Verify the total against the sum of the records.
6. Report the check and stop before sending or publishing.

## Behavior tests
- Complete data: total consistent with the sum.
- Incomplete data: pending item visible, with no fabricated numbers.
- Request out of scope: explain the limitation; don’t run external actions.

Numa tarefa, um agente pode mudar dez ar: In a task, an agent can change ten files at once. Without history, you don’t know what changed or how to go back to the version that worked. With history, each good version is saved, with date and explanation.
O Git guarda as <b>versões</b> de uma pa: Git stores the versions of a folder; GitHub is a site that can store a copy.
Cada versão salva tem data, autor e uma: Each saved version has a date, an author, and a message that explains the change.

No diário de classe, cada dia ganha uma: In the class diary, each day gets a line with date and signature. Nobody deletes yesterday’s line: they add today’s.
O <span class=\"gterm\" data-def=\"Progr: The Git does the same for a folder. The folder tracked by it is called a repository. Each saved version is called a commit and includes a message that explains the change.

A VPS funciona assim. É um <span class=\: A VPS works like this. It’s a rented virtual server, with memory, disk, and network, in a company called the VPS provider. Users, updates, and programs are your responsibility.

<b>Saldo:</b> o tamanho da máquina segue: Net gain: the machine size follows the program, not the model’s fame.
